nodes.name: Every 5 Minutes
nodes.notes: Polls every 5 minutes. Bypasses Google Drive webhooks to work perfectly on localhost without public HTTPS ports.

nodes.name: List Files in Inbox
nodes.notes: Lists all non-folder files inside the Inbox folder.

parameters.query:
=SELECT 
  '{{ $json.id }}' AS "id", 
  '{{ $json.name ? $json.name.replace(/'/g, "''") : 'unknown' }}' AS "name", 
  '{{ $json.mimeType }}' AS "mimeType", 
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM media_files WHERE gdrive_file_id = '{{ $json.id }}') AS "alreadyExists";

nodes.name: Check DB if Exists
nodes.notes: Queries the DB to check if the file ID already exists, preserving the file metadata.

nodes.name: Is New File?
nodes.notes: Proceeds only if the file was not already processed (alreadyExists is false).

nodes.name: Download File from Drive
nodes.notes: Downloads the full file binary. This is the original quality file that will be sent later.

nodes.name: Is Video?
nodes.notes: Routes videos and photos down different paths.

nodes.name: Extract Photo Metadata
nodes.notes: Extracts metadata, checks for HEIC format, generates idempotency key.

nodes.name: Extract EXIF Data
nodes.notes: Reads EXIF metadata from photo binary.

nodes.name: Save to Media Cache
nodes.notes: Saves original file to the shared media_cache Docker volume.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO media_files (
  gdrive_file_id,
  original_filename,
  mime_type,
  file_size_bytes,
  local_path,
  taken_at,
  camera_model,
  gps_latitude,
  gps_longitude,
  is_video,
  idempotency_key,
  status
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json._asp.gdriveFileId }}',
  '{{ $json._asp.originalFilename }}',
  '{{ $json._asp.mimeType }}',
  {{ $json._asp.fileSize || 0 }},
  '/home/node/media_cache/{{ $json._asp.gdriveFileId }}_{{ $json._asp.originalFilename }}',
  {{ $json._asp.takenAt ? "'" + $json._asp.takenAt + "'" : "'" + $json._asp.driveTimestamp + "'" }},
  {{ $json._asp.cameraModel ? "'" + $json._asp.cameraModel + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json._asp.gpsLat || 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json._asp.gpsLng || 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json._asp.isVideo }},
  '{{ $json._asp.idempotencyKey }}',
  'pending'
)
ON CONFLICT (gdrive_file_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

nodes.name: Error Handler
nodes.notes: Catches any error in this workflow.
